requirements.title: Fixture set covering Arabic, Persian, Hebrew invoice cases
requirements.description: 8 fixtures: connected, lam-alef, harakat, mixed invoice line, digits, Persian, Hebrew, wrapping.
acceptance: fixtures.json has 8 fixtures with text, direction and meaning
JS and Python loaders read it

requirements.title: Automatic judging against a Chromium reference
requirements.description: Classify each library output as pass/partial/fail/mismatch with a diagnosis.
acceptance: Reference and failure variants rendered by Chromium
Known-good and known-bad renders are classified correctly

requirements.title: Matrix of real library outputs
requirements.description: About 15 library configurations rendered and judged into matrix.json with screenshots.
acceptance: npm run matrix produces results/matrix.json and screenshots
Errors and unsupported fixtures are recorded, not hidden

requirements.title: Static site and agent files
requirements.description: Grid page, per-library pages, matrix.json, llms.txt, skill file.
acceptance: npm start builds and serves the site
Generated files are derived only from matrix.json

requirements.title: Check command and GitHub Action
requirements.description: Judge a user's own PDF/PNG for a fixture; Action wraps the command.
acceptance: check exits non-zero on a failing render

requirements.title: Nothing fake shown as real
requirements.description: Verdicts are machine-judged and labelled so; no invented results.
acceptance: Site labels verdicts as automatic until reviewed
